question: Which CPU-visible stores and unresolved readers prevent an unconditional tiling replay-worker bypass?

scope.boundary: Static store and reader classification within the inspected scope. No exhaustive alias analysis, actual callback link, host implementation or runtime safety result.

dependencies.use: Defines the mapped-program versus supported-flat input qualification; cited semantic native windows avoid every mismatch range.
Defines the separate allocation, fence and EndTiling reservation contracts.
Defines qualified worker event waits and the presentation order that depends on a condition.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only no-analysis queries through tools/run-headless.ps1 using ghidra/DumpFunctions.java, ghidra/DumpMemoryWords.java, ghidra/FindPointerValues.java, ghidra/DumpReferences.java and ghidra/FindDirectCallers.java; narrow exact-function generated corroboration.
currentEvidence.decompilerLimit: Canonical function bodies truncate at Xenon save thunks or undecoded instructions. Native word windows support the listed instruction sites; sparse decoded-reference absence is not a reader-absence proof.
currentEvidence.inputQualification: native-renderer-shader-fetch-patch.json#/currentEvidence/inputQualification applies. Broad raw scan counts describe that mapped program, not an exhaustive reader census of an unmodified image.

objectIdentity.claim: The selected constructor arm stores W=G+0x2AC0 and CPU ordinal i into Q_i+0 and Q_i+4, where Q_i=G+0x2C3C+80*i, and supplies Q_i to the materialized 0x826ABEA8 thread entry.
objectIdentity.qualification: Current object identity, successful initialization, CPU selection and lifetime still depend on conditions that are not established.

storeFamilies.claim: Reservation loops increment the word before each event wait and decrement it afterward.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: The same reservation loops read the word. Other aliases and imported-kernel effects are not closed.

storeFamilies.claim: Reservation loops acquire the worker lock, can rewrite its old word on a failed comparison, and release it with zero.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: Worker lock loops read the word; all external aliases remain unknown.

storeFamilies.claim: The interpreter updates loop ordinals, payload and continuation pointers, CPU participation, pending and current lists and the per-CPU queue consumer.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: The interpreter, end-of-list handler and thread queue comparisons read these fields. This does not classify every image reader.

storeFamilies.claim: Token 0x8C000000 installs a function pointer and context from the following two words. The interpreter later loads the pointer and calls it indirectly.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: The actual installed target, transitive writes and their nonworker readers are unresolved.

storeFamilies.claim: The interpreter updates phase and barrier words and a token-supplied mask. It spins on W+0x60 at 0x826ABE24 and compares the barrier count against W+0x3C.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: Same-worker readers are identified; exhaustive nonworker readers remain unknown.

storeFamilies.claim: Token arms store flags, nesting, masks, list checkpoints and pending work. The call at 0x826AB8A8 requests a 248-byte copy into W+0x6C.

storeFamilies.claim: End-of-list processing updates continuation and CPU masks, decrements active participation, advances selected queue consumers and conditionally decrements W+0x40=G+0x2B00 when participation reaches zero and W+0x48 is null.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: Submit and drain read G+0x2B00. Queue consumers alias Q_i+0x3C and are read by the thread and interpreter. Other readers are not closed.

fill255Boundary.question: Does the selected unaligned 255-byte fill retain the adjacent wrapper saves and return normally?
fill255Boundary.call: 0x826A7C10 calls 0x827F7BB0 with full r3=D=F+81, r4=0 and r5=255, returning to 0x826A7C14. Reuse the accepted zero-extended, nonwrapping wrapper frame S=F+352; ABI alignment supplies F mod4=0.
fill255Boundary.predicates: Require preserved executable and LR state, valid ABI-aligned S>=352, nonwrapping address arithmetic, writable mapped [D,D+255), no interfering writer and no destructive physical alias with protected frame and caller bytes. This is the fixed call, not arbitrary sizes or full-SP contexts.
fill255Boundary.prefix: 0x827F7BB0/0x827F7BB4 initializes CTR=256 and 0x827F7BB8 copies D to r6. Alignment testing at 0x827F7BCC/0x827F7BD0 executes the 0x827F7BC4 byte store three times at F+81/F+82/F+83. r5 becomes 252 and r6 becomes F+84; the aligned fourth test exits with CTR=252.
fill255Boundary.groupsAndTail: 0x827F7BD8 selects 15 groups. Four scalar BE32 stores at 0x827F7BE8/0x827F7BEC/0x827F7BF0/0x827F7BF4 execute 15 times with a 16-byte step, covering [F+84,F+324). Three residual BE32 stores at 0x827F7C0C/0x827F7C18/0x827F7C24 cover F+324..F+335. At 0x827F7C2C, 252&3=0; CTR becomes zero and 0x827F7C34 returns through LR without a byte tail. Exactly 66 scalar stores write 255 distinct zero bytes in [F+81,F+336), with no vector or cacheline rounding.
fill255Boundary.returnEffects: Full r3 remains D; final r5=252, r6=F+336 and r0=r4=CTR=0. Only GPR r0/r4/r5/r6, CTR and CR0 are assigned. Final CR0 has EQ=1, LT=GT=0 and SO from unchanged XER.SO. Actual r1/SP, full r31, other GPRs, LR, floating and vector registers, XER and other CR fields remain unchanged. The leaf has no data read, stack access, outgoing call or explicit cache operation.
fill255Boundary.saveRetention: The fill excludes byte F+80, backchain [F,F+4), full saved r31 [F+336,F+344) and saved low32 LR [F+344,F+348). Full working r31=P and actual SP=F survive. The live leaf LR is the fill continuation 0x826A7C14; the wrapper's earlier return remains in its saved cell. This settles preservation of the saved values for this call only.
fill255Boundary.counterexample: An independent byte-address model checked four supplied aligned frames, including F=0xFFFFFE90, for exact set equality and save exclusion. Incorrectly preserving original count 255 for post-prefix tails produces 258 bytes and overwrites saved-r31 offsets F+336..F+338. An aligned-only fill proof therefore cannot justify this unaligned call without the changed count.
